purpose: IPO Terminal research knowledge store for transcript-backed IPO selection

sources.title: How to Select Better IPO
summary: Understand the business, customers, competition and growth runway.
Compare valuation with listed peers instead of judging an IPO in isolation.
Check multi-year revenue and profit growth.
Review ROE, ROCE, EBITDA and PAT together.
Check debt and D/E for financial flexibility and leverage risk.
Separate fresh issue from OFS because the use of proceeds is different.
Review promoter holding and promoter selling.
Read DRHP/RHP risk factors, litigation, customer concentration, related parties and use of proceeds.
Use QIB, NII and retail subscription as demand evidence when available.
Use GMP only as a secondary, unofficial sentiment signal.
Make the final decision from business quality, valuation, financial strength, issue structure and demand together.

application_decisions.output: For each selected category, IPO type and lot count, show #1 first preference, next preferences, IPO name, Mainboard/SME type, lot size and application amount.
application_decisions.amount_rule: available upper price × lot size × selected lots
application_decisions.gmp_rule: GMP is unofficial secondary sentiment; invalid or extreme values must be ignored
application_decisions.missing_data_rule: Missing data lowers confidence and should not automatically make an IPO look weak.
application_decisions.transcript_priority: When the user provides the video transcript, extract its exact decision principles and apply them with higher priority than the current educational summary.

one_lot_decision.purpose: Rank IPOs for a person who can apply for one lot, using evidence quality and transcript-backed selection principles rather than a generic popularity score.
one_lot_decision.decision_question: If I can apply for only one IPO lot, which available IPO has the strongest evidence-based case?
one_lot_decision.output: Show #1 one-lot candidate, shortlist, reasons, risks, minimum lot investment, evidence coverage and confidence.

two_lot_decision.decision_question: If I can apply for two lots, which IPO should receive the two-lot application priority?
two_lot_decision.output: Show #1 two-lot candidate and application amount, plus next preferences and Mainboard/SME type.

three_lot_decision.decision_question: If I can apply for three lots, which IPO should receive the three-lot application priority?
three_lot_decision.output: Show #1 three-lot candidate and application amount, plus next preferences and Mainboard/SME type.

transcript_ingestion.next_action: replace transcript_status and transcript when user provides the transcript, then extract transcript-specific decision rules
